verdict.rationale: Loops supports some one-to-many actions: campaigns send to a whole segment at once, every plan allows uploading unlimited contacts, and the CLI's JSON output makes it scriptable. The documented API endpoints, however, work on a single item (create or update one contact, send one event or transactional email), and nothing describes a native batch or bulk endpoint, so bulk changes need loops in scripts or agents. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API or CLI operations (e.g. batch contact upsert/delete, bulk list changes), details of the bulk contact import mechanism, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
